high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from the website "timesnownews.com." The article's title reads: "The Rejection That Made Gabriel García Márquez Lock Himself in a Room and Change Literature Forever." The text of the article begins by describing how Gabriel García Márquez was on the verge of giving up after years of rejection when inspiration struck during a drive to Acapulco. It mentions that he locked himself away for 18 months, writing "One Hundred Years of Solitude" in poverty and obsession.
